The full suite passes: 376 tests across all 17 test files, each file finishing in under a second. The earlier background run produced nothing, probably because that compound command hung. I didn't find out why, and the suite itself isn't slow. The `-eq` errors in the output come from a bug in my loop's timeout check under zsh, not from the tests.

That covers behaviour only. I still haven't timed a real Northwind October run, so I can't give you a before-and-after figure. Since the rate is now read once per country instead of once per line, the tax-lookup time should drop sharply. Please time the real run on your side to confirm.
